# ROI AI Trading

## About
ROI AI Trading is an AI-powered automated trading platform that provides users with daily returns through algorithmic trading strategies.

## Core Features
- AI-powered automated trading
- Real-time earnings dashboard
- Multiple investment plans (Weekly, 15 Days, Monthly)
- Secure deposits via Easypaisa, JazzCash, and Crypto
- Transparent withdrawal system
- 24/7 customer support
